title: Creative Producer - Web Summit Rio de Janeiro
description:
About us:

How did Web Summit become, in the words of Forbes, “the best tech conference on the planet”? Meaningful connections. Our tech events are unmissable because we make it easier for the right people to meet and connect. Everyone at Web Summit works towards this goal.

And we’re just getting started.

We’re always looking to build on the impact we have already made at Web Summit. In the coming years we’ll take Web Summit to new markets, promoting global connectivity, highlighting important issues and connecting global leaders – all while making a positive impact on the environment and communities we encounter.

To build a better company, we have to better ourselves. We do that by finding the most ambitious people to work with us.

The role:

We’re looking for a Creative Producer to join our growing Content Team for Web Summit Rio .

You’ll be responsible for curating, shaping, and delivering high-calibre on-stage content. From speaker booking to on-site production, this is a fast-paced, high-impact role where editorial meets execution.


What you will do
  • Industry Research: Track trends, identify leading voices, and stay ahead of emerging startups and technologies across relevant industries.
  • Speaker Booking: Secure high-profile and A-list speakers, especially for our Centre Stage. You’ll lead outreach, negotiations, and coordination with speakers and their teams.
  • Editorial Ownership: Shape the narrative of our stages. Work with speakers to define compelling topics, formats, and titles. Write talk descriptions, moderator briefs, and technical scripts.
  • Live Production: Manage speaker logistics and live rehearsals. Ensure all assets are prepped and stages run smoothly on-site, collaborating with technical and production teams.
  • Platform & Data Management: Maintain accurate records using our internal platforms and tools. Attention to detail and flawless admin are essential to your success.
  • Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with speakers, companies, and stakeholders before, during, and after the event.
  • Internal Expertise: Be a source of insight and strategic advice for internal teams. You’ll act as the go-to expert for your speaker tracks and industries.
Skills and abilities we're looking for
  • You’re consistently booking high-quality, relevant speakers for Centre Stage and beyond.
  • You aim to confirm at least 4 A-list speakers per year across your content verticals.
  • You stay ahead of industry shifts and consistently maintain a strong research pipeline with timely, strategic outreach.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively with your manager, particularly around pipeline challenges.
  • You demonstrate strong editorial judgment , creating engaging formats and talk titles that resonate with our global audience.
  • You are a reliable team player who collaborates effectively across departments.
  • Your admin and data tracking are consistently up-to-date and accurate, supporting seamless internal operations.
Who you are
  • Ideally, 2–4 years of experience in production, content, editorial, or events (or adjacent industries)
  • Strong interest in tech, innovation, entrepreneurship, or media
  • Confident communicator with experience engaging high-profile individuals and companies
  • Exceptional organisational and writing skills
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)
  • Experience with tools like CRMs, Google Suite, and other productivity platforms is a plus

Benefits and perks:

- Hybrid-working model open to all employees.

- Fully subsidised healthcare, dental, employee assistance programme (EAP) and more.

- Pension contribution up to 6%(Irish based only)

- A dedicated in-house L&D department, with access to workshops, online learning and resources to help you excel in your career development.

- Company laptop, generous annual leave and flexible working arrangements.

- Our very own Tramway Team, which drives community and morale-boosting events for employees to participate in.

- Annual company get-togethers, charity days, and monthly wellbeing talks.

- Wellness subsidy issued to all employees of €1000 per year

At Web Summit, we embrace diversity and inclusion. We want talent from all walks of life to help us on our journey to digitise the conference sector. Hiring decisions are made purely on experience, skills and the needs of the business.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager role at Canonical

2 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
This is a general track for first-level engineering management positions at Canonical.
We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable, and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding developers themselves. They should be completely at home reviewing a patch or a software design spec. They are trusted engineers who understand the importance of a whole-team effort in creating great products and who enjoy seeing colleagues develop. They should contribute code themselves to set the standard for coding, but know that the code they write is far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team's direction, focus, and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers who are interested in soft skills to be managers.
A typical first-level software engineering team is based in a single time zone, such as EMEA or Americas, or APAC, with an Engineering Manager and a Senior Engineer dedicated to a single product, who work as a team to shape the roadmap, technical strategy, code, documentation, and community engagement. They are both capable of coding, and are both leaders comfortable assigning work and maintaining expectations of delivery. They will both be expected to take management training at Canonical so they speak the same language when it comes to team behaviours, habits, routines, norms, and standards, but they focus on different sides of the problem.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
We have open manager roles across a wide range of engineering domains, including:

  • Python and Golang
  • C / C++ / Rust
  • Data infrastructure
  • HTML / CSS / JavaScript / Typescript / React
  • Flutter
  • Distro packaging and systems
  • SAAS and web microservices
  • Kernel
  • Servers
  • Graphics, Browser and Desktop
  • Silicon enablement and embedded devices
  • Product Security
If your domain of expertise isn't listed above, yet you feel it's relevant to Canonical, then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team.
Location: we have engineering management positions open in every time zone
What you'll do
  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone, sometimes two
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we're looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • A love of developing and growing people and a track record of it
  • Experience in leading, coaching, and mentoring software developers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high-quality results
  • Well-organised, self-starting, and able to deliver to schedule
  • Professional manner of interacting with colleagues, partners, and the community
  • You have advanced expertise in your domain
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • You have a demonstrated drive for continual learning
  • Builds trust, relationships, and confidence
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills We Value
  • Experience in a developer advocacy or community role
  • Ops and system administration experience
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa Gerente Tributária - Preços de Transferência você será parte da área de Tax atuando com foco em TP (Preços de Transferência) e apoiando na definição de preços dos produtos produzidos no exterior e vendidos no Brasil. We are building documentation capacity at scale. We have dozens of positions available , for products and teams across the organisation, at all levels from Graduate to Senior Staff.
All applications and candidates are handled through this one entry-point. We'll be able to discuss seniority levels, suitable teams and more later in the process, to help place you in the most suitable role for you.
The role of a Technical Author
A Technical Author leads the documentation efforts of an engineering team, typically focused on a product or family of products. You'll help the team develop documentation that serves the needs of the product's users, embracing the principles of the Diátaxis documentation framework. You will have a broad impact on - and responsibility for - the quality of the user experience with the product, and will contribute towards the long-term success of the project itself.
These are not traditional technical writer roles. As a Technical Author, you will participate in development of product strategy. You will have input into product design and user experience. You will combine technical expertise with leadership in documentation, collaborating with colleagues across the company to establish documentation as a first-class engineering discipline. Even the most junior Technical Authors will have the opportunity to develop and demonstrate technical authority.
As well as your role in an engineering team, you will also be a part of Canonical's documentation practice team, that includes all the company's Technical Authors. Here, you'll be amongst other documentation experts, who collaborate to define documentation excellence and drive the development of documentation practice and theory, across the company and in the open-source software community.
Location: These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
The role entails

  • Create, maintain and improve software documentation
  • Work with engineering team members, to help them make effective documentation contributions
  • Influence the development of the product, as an expert user of the product, who has important opinions about its function and design
  • Engage with user communities to ensure that our documentation meets their needs
  • Encourage and support community engagement in and contribution to documentation
  • Help standardise the structure, presentation, style and language of content across products
  • Collaborate with documentation peers to advance the state of the art in documentation at Canonical
  • Challenge and advance documentation understanding and best-practice, as part of a disciplinary team
What we are looking for in you
  • Cares deeply about functional written communication
  • Is a technical writer with a programmer's mindset, or a programmer with a record of producing excellent documentation

  • Has experience of software development contexts; is familiar with: Linux, working on the command line, application deployment, system operations, and infrastructure management, Git, documentation markup languages
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Holds a BSc/BA degree or equivalent
  • Is able to travel twice a year for up to two weeks for events
Nice-to-have skills
  • Deep technical domain knowledge

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Alliances Field Engineer to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.
Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.
What we are looking for in you
  • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
  • Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time

What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!

  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

  11. Participar na padronização de insumos e na análise técnica de grupos e comissões.
  12. Realizar visitas técnicas a fornecedores e promover treinamentos para a equipe.
  13. Estabelecer indicadores de desempenho do setor.
  14. Comunicar-se com o corpo clínico e de enfermagem sobre medicamentos padronizados e substitutos, promovendo orientações técnicas.

  17. Assegurar ações de farmacovigilância e notificações legais.

  19. Dar suporte à farmácia logística quando necessário.

Join to apply for the Associate Director of Creative (AI) role at Darkroom

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.
Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. 5000 (2023), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).
We are looking for an experienced and talented Associate Director of Creative to join our team.
The Associate Director of Creative is a player/coach designer who will work as a manager of a pod of Designers, as well as delivering your own AI-powered Creative Direction, Marketing Design, and UI/UX Design engagements at high bar of client services and visual quality. You bring expertise in integrating AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Midjourney into your workflows to drive efficiency. You thrive on finding new ways to use AI to break barriers and being on the cutting edge of this paradigm shift.
In this role, you’ll report to the Director of Creative. You’ll use your strong design background to be an advocate for our design processes and philosophy, and supervise a small cohort of Designers by providing feedback on their work to develop their skillsets across paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. Your main focus in the first 60 days will be helping the creative team integrate ChatGPT and AI into their work to discover and implement efficiencies. You’ll bring your expertise in AI workflows to help build processes and trainings with the Director of Creative. You’ll also be responsible for owning Creative Direction engagements that impact paid marketing and organic channels for e-commerce clients.
We’re looking for a candidate with deep experience in using AI to power their work at a commercial level, and who can apply this experience to the direction and development of junior designers. A strong candidate has a best-in-class visual eye, attention-to-detail, and client services acumen.
This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.
Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 1-2 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.
Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:
  • Be a champion for AI-powered work, holding trainings on best practices for the team and building efficient workflows for the team in partnership with the Director of Creative.
  • Lead Creative Direction engagements focused on transforming paid or organic marketing channels through deliverables like content calendars, creative briefs, and strategic proposals.
  • Lead 1-2 UI/UX engagements as capacity allows, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites. Emphasize branded UI, conversion-focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design and creative direction work to clients, explaining choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand-off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:
  • 3-6+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in creative direction, marketing design, or responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design, marketing design, and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience working with AI tools and producing client-ready assets powered by AI outputs is required.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand-off.
  • Comfortable with client-facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:
  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Darkroom offers a Phantom Equity Incentive Plan—a long-term, seniority-based cash bonus that vests over five years and pays out if the company is sold, rewarding those who help us grow.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.
MAAS components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. This role is one of our general tracks. Apply here for all engineering teams at Canonical who work on low-level system technology on autonomous devices across all seniority levels.
We hire careful and conscientious engineers who appreciate the challenge of memory, performance, battery and connectivity constrained code that has to work every time in an unreliable and unforgiving world, on x86, ARM or RISC-V silicon.
Canonical Ubuntu is the leading Linux for software engineers, desktops, cloud and IoT. We bring open source to the world as a high-performance, safe and secure platform for enterprise computing, software engineering, and connected devices.
These smart, connected devices have the potential to transform every industry. Classic Ubuntu – desktop or server – is widely used in embedded systems because of its developer focus and enterprise grade security maintenance. We partner with the world's most prominent silicon companies to optimise Ubuntu on their latest and greatest chips, as well as with major OEMs and ODMs (PC, servers and connected device manufacturers) to ensure that Ubuntu works perfectly on their hardware.
But while classic, 'deb' based Ubuntu is ideal for developers, it has too much variability for appliance or connected device environments, where you want to know *exactly* what the state of millions or billions of devices might be. So Canonical builds Ubuntu Core, a fully containerised version of Ubuntu that is mathematically precise and rigorously secure. We are working on additional solutions for even smaller devices.
We have several teams that focus on open source for embedded environments. We hire outstanding Linux software engineers with a passion for open source, innovation, cutting-edge hardware and software technologies in general. You will be expected to make significant contributions through high-quality design and code, and to develop your technical leadership.

The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical
Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.
Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

$50,000.00/yr - $65,000.00/yr

Join as an early engineer and build products to prevent financial crime.
Sandbar
Sandbar's mission is to improve the health of the global financial system by fighting money laundering and other financial crimes.
By law, financial institutions must monitor transactions for illicit activity. However, most institutions find it difficult to do so effectively. Roughly $6T is laundered every year and $180B is spent on anti-money-laundering efforts by US institutions. Despite this, less than 1% of laundered money is identified correctly. We are also seeing many systems produce false-positive rates of over 95%. Consequently, banks and the government must spend extra time and resources on extraneous investigations, taking away resources from finding criminals.
Product
To achieve our goal, we ingest and standardize millions of messy data points coming from financial institutions that may sign up for the service. Once we have standardized and ingested the data, we can run complex calculations on it, checking for suspicious behavior and building a score around the riskiness of a given profile. If anything is found, we can surface that to our clients. By providing information accessibility, building intuitive workflows, allowing for custom processing, and curating accurate data, we can reduce the false-positive rate of our calculations, and reduce the amount of work dedicated to a given investigation.
You
We are looking for engineers who are excited about building a company from the ground up. As a founding engineer at Sandbar, you'll be responsible for defining and building features in our product to enable our customers to model and detect suspicious activity on their platforms. You'll work cross-functionally, collaborating with members of the team who have expertise in the subject matter, product management, design, infrastructure and security, to solve real-world problems our customers face. You'll have a lot of autonomy and freedom. You will learn and touch almost every part of the stack; big bonus if you're comfortable being a "Swiss Army knife". As we grow, you will be able to determine your own path and build skills you want to develop by directing your career growth and specialization. You're excited by and personally interested in how AI is reshaping they way we build products and solve problems; and you want to use it for positive far-reaching, real-world impact.
Team
We’re a small, but mighty and collaborative team based in NYC focused on delivering world-class software for our clients. You will not be in NYC, but you will visit NYC every now and then. And multiple people from our NYC office will visit you more often; in-person collaboration is priceless in the early days of building an enduring business so we will do our best to continue that value with our Central and South American teammates. We've raised from some amazing investors and have a group of amazing advisors and partners who can help us build the right things. This includes 3 institutional VC funds––Lachy Groom, Abstract Ventures, and BoxGroup––and 45+ angel investors including founders, executives, and early employees of Ramp, Stripe, Plaid, Remitly, Revolut, Google, Open AI, Square, and more.
What You'll Do

  • Work with a broad range of technologies and systems to own and solve problems end-to-end.
  • Work closely with engineers, designers, and product managers to build new features in our product and data platform.
  • Contribute to our technical vision and uphold our high engineering standards.
  • Leverage new technologies like AI to continuously uplevel the quality and speed of delivery.
What You'll Need
  • 5 years of relevant work experience.
  • Great communication skills, and a high degree of awareness and agency.
  • Track record of delivering high-quality products and features end-to-end.
  • Ability to turn real-world problems and opportunities into engineering solutions.
  • Desire to work in a highly collaborative environment, and to continuously grow and master your craft.
  • Experience or willingness to heavily leverage new technologies like AI in your code and the product itself.
Nice-to-haves
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Pulumi, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of SQL and experience with Postgres.
  • Experience with Flink, Iceberg, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working in a large Java codebase.
  • Experience with Python, a growing part of our codebase.
  • Experience with Typescript, Next.js, React, and MUI.
  • Experience using AI-based development tools like Cursor, etc.
Benefits

  • Commuter benefits.
  • Access to an office if you want to go in.
  • Free lunches everyday.
Sandbar celebrates diversity and welcomes applications from all backgrounds. Additionally, we value potential and growth, so even if you don’t feel that you fulfill all of the criteria, you should still feel comfortable applying, and your application will be considered fairly.

description:

Associate, Client Success Operations

About Us

GSCF | | Rio de Janeiro – Brazil

GSCF is a leading fintech company in the working capital finance space, serving some of the largest tech manufacturers globally. By funding, structuring, and servicing accounts receivables portfolios for our customers, we help companies get the most out of their working capital. We help our customers grow their sales, strengthen their balance sheets, and eliminate risk.

Our formation in 2021 gives us a start-up culture and mindset, while our origins bring deep industry knowledge, extensive specialized expertise, and geographic reach across 59 countries. Despite being a new player in our space, GSCF serviced more than $60 billion in tech accounts receivables volumes in 2021. We are wholly owned and funded by Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager, which provides us with a large and flexible funding pool, significant relationships, and strategic guidance.

Our field, global working capital finance, represents a $5.5 trillion total addressable market that is expected to grow an additional 50% by 2026, driven by increased supply chain complexity, digitization of the invoicing process and growing demand for longer payment terms. Our aim is to become the global leader in the working capital finance space.

GSCF is a global employer with more than 300 employees across 20+ countries.

The Role:

The Client Success Operations Team is responsible for the diligent management of the assigned Buyers including country specifics, client servicing, service delivery, exceptions processing, program monitoring and risks reporting.

How You Will Make an Impact:

  • Support clients across Americas geography.
  • Develop and maintain a strong working relationship with numerous customer contacts at various levels of the organization and serves as a focal point for customer inquiries, requests, and complaints.
  • Provide information by collecting, analyzing and summarizing data, and responding to requests.
  • Ensure accuracy and efficiency of operations including collection and monitoring of receivables.
  • Prepare materials for use in status account reviews conducted at multiple corporate levels.
  • Responsible for territory risk management and customer satisfaction attainment.
  • Ensure all customer communications are documented in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Ensure accounts operate within approved guidelines and obtain the appropriate level of management approval in exception situations.
  • Keep customers appraised of the financial health of their account and its ability to support current and future financing volumes.
  • Proactive account management with effective communication skills.
  • Operate pro-actively at all times.
  • Timely reporting/escalating of risks, exceptions, incidents to Upline Managers.
  • Ensure agreements and all programs relevant procedures are updated regularly and safely stored on its respective file cabinets.
  • Share knowledge, initiatives and find better ideas to improve external and internal client satisfaction.
  • Support additional ad-hoc projects.
  • Adhere to company & operations policies.
  • Contribute to maintaining a positive, transparent, open and creative thinking working environment.
  • From time to time, willing to take over tasks/projects which are not related directly to this function.
  • Multicultural sensitivity/awareness.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Fluent in English and Spanish.
  • Experience in handling complex and sensitive accounts.
  • Excellent analytical & problem-solving skills.
  • Thrives in a multi-task environment where there are competing priorities and deadlines/deliverables.
  • Ability to remain poised and calm under pressure.
  • Structured, fact-based way of work.
  • Prioritization

  • Strong communication skills both verbal and written.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Team player – energetic, enthusiastic, and personable.

As the Software Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Gaming, your mission is to help make gaming on Ubuntu first-class. In this exciting time for Linux gaming, compatibility tools like Proton have matured, but a well-rounded gaming experience goes beyond compatibility. It entails maximising performance, robust and secure anti-cheat mechanisms, full device support, and ease of content creation, sharing and discovery. By collaborating with open-source projects and other partners, you'll contribute to not just Ubuntu but the wider Linux gaming ecosystem.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

Our Project Managers are responsible for ensuring project success through owning, driving, communicating and respectfully engaging all stakeholders, valuing integrity and accountability.

The successful Junior Project Manager will have solid academic achievement in science, software engineering and/or information technology field, excellent written and verbal communications skills in English and a solution oriented mindset. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. title: CNU: edital do curso de formação profissional é publicado
description:
CNU: edital do curso de formação profissional é publicado

Os cursos ocorrerão entre março e abril, em Brasília e no Rio de Janeiro

O Concurso Nacional Unificado (CNU) segue avançando, e as agências reguladoras já publicaram o edital do Curso de Formação Profissional (CFP).

A etapa será obrigatória para candidatos a determinados cargos e ocorrerá entre março e abril.

Publicação do edital do CFP

O edital do CFP foi publicado no Diário Oficial da União nesta segunda-feira (3) e traz informações sobre a carga horária, locais e prazos de matrícula. Além disso, foi divulgada uma retificação do edital CNU sobre a divulgação das notas finais após a conclusão do curso.

  • ANEEL e Antaq : Brasília/DF, entre 24 de março e 16 de abril de 2025.
  • ANS : Rio de Janeiro/RJ, no mesmo período.

A divulgação do link para matrícula e os procedimentos para envio da documentação via upload ocorrerão no site do Cebraspe, no dia 12 de março de 2025 .

Divulgação do resultado final e convocação

No dia 4 de fevereiro , será divulgada a primeira lista de classificação dos candidatos dos blocos 1 ao 7 e a primeira convocação para os cargos que exigem curso de formação.

Os candidatos deverão acessar a Área do Candidato nos dias 4 e 5 de fevereiro para verificar sua convocação.

A confirmação da presença no CFP é obrigatória. O candidato precisa responder “SIM” à convocação para garantir sua vaga. Caso responda “NÃO”, será eliminado da vaga para a qual foi convocado, mas seguirá concorrendo a outras opções indicadas na inscrição.

Atualização das listas de convocação

As listas de convocação serão atualizadas conforme as confirmações de participação. Novas convocações ocorrerão nas seguintes datas:

  • 11 de fevereiro : Segunda lista de classificação e nova convocação para os cursos de formação.
  • 18 de fevereiro : Terceira lista de classificação e última convocação para os cursos.
  • 28 de fevereiro : Lista definitiva de classificação dos aprovados dos blocos 1 ao 7 e lista final de convocados para matrícula no CFP.

Cursos de formação: modalidades e remuneração

Os cursos serão oferecidos nas modalidades presencial e híbrida , com durações variando entre 140 e 580 horas . A divisão ocorrerá da seguinte forma:

  • Presencial : Em Brasília para a maioria dos cargos e no Rio de Janeiro para Especialista em Regulação de Saúde Suplementar (ANS).
  • Híbrido : Para Auditor-Fiscal do Trabalho (AFT), com parte presencial em Brasília e parte online.

Durante o curso de formação, os candidatos receberão 50% do salário inicial , exceto aqueles que já são servidores públicos. Além disso, não haverá cobrança de taxa de matrícula .

Importância do CFP no concurso CNU

O Curso de Formação Profissional é uma fase eliminatória e classificatória para os cargos que o exigem. Apenas os candidatos que concluírem essa etapa com aprovação poderão ser nomeados para os respectivos cargos.

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Business Services Team Manager role at Canonical

14 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Business Services Team Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.
This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.
We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.
This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.
Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.
Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.
Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing
Leadership and accountability
This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure these events run smoothly.
As a manager, your team would be responsible for

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices
What we are looking for
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO:

O Executivo de Contas para o canal autosserviço será responsável pela gestão e desenvolvimento das contas existentes dentro deste canal, com foco em resultados comerciais. Este profissional terá como principal objetivo maximizar a venda e a distribuição de produtos da empresa, por meio de negociações eficazes e estratégias comerciais direcionadas para o autosserviço. O papel envolve a manutenção de relacionamentos sólidos com os clientes, identificação de oportunidades de expansão e garantia de resultados sustentáveis para ambos os lados.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  1. Gestão de Contas no Canal Autosserviço: Desenvolver e gerenciar carteira de clientes, focando na maximização de vendas e expansão do portfólio. Alcançar metas e aumentar a penetração de produtos.
  2. Negociação e Maximização de Resultados: Conduzir negociações estratégicas, renovação de contratos e acordos de fornecimento. Estabelecer metas de vendas e rentabilidade, equilibrando necessidades do cliente e objetivos da empresa.
  3. Gestão de Performance e Resultados: Monitorar KPIs de vendas, giro de produtos e volumes de distribuição. Implementar ações corretivas e promocionais para alcançar metas e manter competitividade.
  4. Estratégias Comerciais e Merchandising: Implementar estratégias de vendas, promoções e merchandising, em colaboração com marketing e trade marketing, para aumentar visibilidade e demanda dos produtos.
  5. Gestão de Estoques: Colaborar para garantir abastecimento eficiente, evitando rupturas e excesso de produtos. Otimizar distribuição para presença nas prateleiras.
  6. Relatórios e Análises Comerciais: Elaborar relatórios de vendas e performance, apresentando resultados e insights para ajustes estratégicos e melhoria de processos.

REQUISITOS:

  1. Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Economia, ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Experiência comprovada no setor de alimentos e bebidas, preferencialmente com foco no canal autosserviço. Experiência em negociação, desenvolvimento de contas e atingimento de metas comerciais;
  3. Conhecimento do mercado de alimentos e bebidas, especialmente no canal autosserviço será considerado um diferencial.

HABILIDADES:

  1. Sólido entendimento de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e capacidade analítica para tomada de decisão.
  2. Visão estratégica e foco em resultados de longo prazo.
  3. Habilidade em gerenciamento de tempo, priorização de tarefas e organização.
  4. Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaboração com diferentes departamentos.
  5. Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e Excel.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Técnico em Meio Ambiente . O profissional será inserido em projeto de eficiência energética, cuja lógica é a de troca de resíduos recicláveis por bônus na fatura de energia elétrica. Tal iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O profissional terá como responsabilidade principal a elaboração de Estudos de Viabilidade Técnica - EVT, emissão e controle de Manifesto de Transporte de Resíduos - MTR, processamento de dados e emissão de relatórios. Além disso, fornecerá suporte abrangente às atividades do projeto, auxiliando o Supervisor de Operação nas rotinas de monitoramento dos pontos de coleta fixos e itinerantes, e deverá apoiar o Coordenador do projeto no acompanhamento das atividades e metas gerais.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Produzir Estudo de Viabilidade Técnica (EVT) relacionado ao gerenciamento de resíduos recicláveis;
  2. Identificar e contatar potenciais clientes, especialmente grandes geradores de resíduos, em busca de novas parcerias;
  3. Produzir Estudo de Viabilidade Técnica - EVT, para avaliação de novos parceiros e abertura de ecopontos, bem como emitir e controlar os MTR - Manifesto de Transporte de Resíduos, produzidos pelos ecopontos;
  4. Manter contato e relacionamento proativo com os clientes do projeto;
  5. Aumentar o nível qualitativo das coletas dos grandes geradores por meio da execução de assistências técnicas, treinamentos e palestras sobre melhores práticas de gerenciamento de resíduos;
  6. Identificar e promover o tratamento de eventuais não conformidades;
  7. Alimentar os indicadores do projeto e emitir relatórios periódicos de desempenho;
  8. Auxiliar e prestar suporte operacional sempre que necessário ao Supervisor de Operações.

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Reservoir Engineer
description:
The position involves supporting all reservoir engineering activities, including oil and gas reserve estimation, production forecasting, reservoir simulation, and production optimization, while also demonstrating an understanding of geoscience concepts, drilling, completions, and production operations.

• Expert in integrated reservoir simulation studies, including data analysis and integration, model construction, history matching, calibration and predictions.

• Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both NPV and hydrocarbon recovery.

• Competent in the analysis of capillary pressure, relative permeability and PVT data.

• Competent in compositional reservoir modeling.

• Participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.

• Evaluates and initiates exploitation opportunities, including new drilling and work-overs to maximize reserves recovery and booking, and overall play economics.

• Prepare data and perform PTA interpretation and modeling.

• Formulate the strategies for reservoir development, data acquisition, field surveillance and monitor masterplans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.

• Extensive working knowledge of standard vendor applications for pre and post-processing of simulation data and Assisted History Matching software and workflows.

• Is familiar with field production activities to effectively implement reservoir management aspects during the field production phase, including liaison with regulatory agencies.

• Develop Life of Field production profiles and maintain auditable booked reserves estimates and reserves reports

• Coordinate and integrate data, simulation and studies between Artificial lift, production, and dynamic modeling to support the other areas.

• Work with the Production Engineer/Technologist to optimize well potentials.

• Write concise reports for all studies and maintain comprehensive, accessible and up-to-date records of input and interpreted data.

• Coordinates with the business development on acquisition and divestiture projects. Supports the reservoir engineering evaluation component of company acquisition


Education

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Petroleum Engineering.

• Long relevant experience may compensate for formal education

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience with reservoir engineering within the oil and gas industry.

• Reservoir engineering, reservoir management and reservoir simulation skills are essential.

• Proven track record in performing reservoir modeling and field development studies.

• Pressure transient analysis (PTA) interpretation experience will be a plus.
Knowledge

• High proficiency in any reservoir simulation software (Eclipse or T-Nav preferred)

• Proficiency in any production software like Pipesim and/or Prosper.

• Experience with any pressure transient analysis software like Kappa or Pansystem.

title: Technical Purchaser
description:
This position is responsible for the procurement of medium to large equipment packages, ensuring adherence to Supply Chain procedures and alignment with project-specific requirements. The role involves managing the full procurement cycle — from requisition to delivery — while working closely with internal departments, suppliers, and logistics to guarantee timely, cost-effective, and compliant operations. It also includes contract negotiation, supplier performance management, and continuous contribution to process improvement and strategic sourcing initiatives.

  • Responsible for the procurement of medium to large equipment packages, in accordance with SC procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with BW Energy’s SC procedures and project-specific Procurement Plans.
  • Manage procurement, expediting, and supply chain control from requisition to onboard delivery.
  • Liaise with freight forwarders and logistics to optimize deliveries and minimize freight/customs costs.
  • Ensure quality and suitability of equipment/spares in coordination with relevant departments.
  • Apply thorough cost control throughout procurement activities.
  • Issue Purchase Orders in IFS and perform material receiving when required.
  • Monitor changes in the supplier market; maintain balanced contact with local and global suppliers.
  • Participate in supplier meetings and contribute to supplier relationship development.
  • Maintain commodity knowledge and oversee the development of the Bidders List.
  • Support implementation and understanding of frame agreements and identify needs for new agreements.
  • Prepare and issue RFQs.
  • Evaluate bids, perform clarifications, and negotiate with suppliers.
  • Analyze TCO / Life Cycle Costs and recommend awards.
  • Coordinate with Legal on contract terms and supplier qualifications.
  • Participate in the negotiation and implementation of strategic contracts (short, long-term or MSAs).
  • Monitor supplier production schedules and ensure delivery capability.
  • Identify and mitigate risks to delivery schedules.
  • Maintain IFS database accuracy; liaise quarterly with requisitioners to validate open requests.
  • Prepare regular Procurement Status Reports (PSR).
  • Ensure compliance with E&P policies, internal controls, and applicable tax regulations.
  • Guarantee the implementation of contracts for oil lifting operations.
  • Contribute to global SC initiatives and bid inputs for new contracts.
  • Support alignment of local SC practices with global best practices.
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned and best practice adoption.
  • Ensure compliance with local content requirements.


Education

  • Education / degree within Purchasing and/or Logistics Administration will be preferred;
  • Long relevant experience may replace educational requirements.


Experience

  • Ideally, 8 years of working experience within purchase, preferably from Supply Chain within the oil & gas or marine related industry;
  • Previous experience with ERP systems.

Knowledge

  • In-depth knowledge of the local supply market for the oil & gas industry and general knowledge to the international oil & gas supplier market;
  • Familiar with the terminology of the oil & gas industry;
  • Good understanding/knowledge of ERP systems;
  • Technical knowledge/understanding of the oil & gas industry is an advantage.
  • Advanced English (oral and written);
  • Understanding and knowledge of the technical, contractual, and commercial issues related to the design and engineering of Floating, Production, Storage, and Offloading vessels is an advantage.

Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager (Remote)

Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager (Remote)

MonetizeMore is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising. ecosystem.
Job Overview
We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.
Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.)
    • Manage budgets, bids, and targeting strategies to maximize campaign performance
    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement
What We're Looking For
  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions
  • Technical Proficiency - Familiarity with digital advertising tools and platforms like Google Ad Manager, WordPress, GAM 360, traffic acquisition tool such sa Active Campaign and header bidding solutions
  • Problem-Solving Skills - Resourceful in identifying issues, troubleshooting errors, and finding effective solutions
  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively

title: Product Owner
description:
Job description

Na Supercomm , somos mais do que uma empresa de tecnologia; somos arquitetos de soluções que simplificam o mundo e impulsionam o futuro. Fundada em 2012 , nossa jornada é marcada por uma paixão inabalável por inovar e entregar valor, combinando Venda Consultiva , um forte Canal Digital e Eficiência Operacional em cada passo que damos.

Somos uma empresa com uma visão ousada. Este é o resultado de uma expansão estratégica para cinco categorias de negócio – de Impressão & Suprimentos a Telecomunicações, Serviços, Telecomunicações Enterprise e até um Banco Digital – demonstrando nossa adaptabilidade e ambição.

Nossos valores são o coração da Supercomm: Respeito ao indivíduo em primeiro lugar, a Velocidade para nos movermos rápido e aprendermos com os erros, a Valorização que gera valor para todos os envolvidos, e o Crescimento que nos desafia a inovar e a nos desenvolver constantemente. Se você busca um lugar para crescer, inovar e ser valorizado, venha construir o futuro da tecnologia conosco!

Sobre a Posição: Seu Impacto como PO na Supercomm

Buscamos uma pessoa Product Owner que será a força motriz por trás da entrega de soluções inovadoras e de alto impacto na Supercomm. Você terá a responsabilidade de liderar projetos complexos, desde a concepção até a implementação, garantindo que nossas iniciativas de tecnologia se traduzam em resultados concretos, alinhados à nossa visão de futuro e à nossa busca incessante por Eficiência Operacional e Atitude Digital .

Sua capacidade de transformar ideias em planos acionáveis, gerenciar equipes multidisciplinares e navegar por desafios com Resolução de Problemas será crucial para o nosso sucesso. Se você tem Espírito Empreendedor e adora ver um projeto sair do papel e gerar valor, este é o seu lugar!


Main responsibilities

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Definição Estratégica : Liderar a análise e aprofundamento de requisitos, definindo o contexto e o "guard rail" (diretrizes estratégicas) para novos produtos e projetos, com um foco especial em soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial aplicadas em atendimento com linguagem natural.
  • Gestão de Projetos : Conduzir o ciclo de vida completo dos projetos, desde a concepção e validação de ideias até o planejamento detalhado e a implementação, garantindo a entrega de valor contínuo.
  • Visão de Mercado e Tecnologia : Realizar a prospecção e avaliação de possíveis fornecedores de tecnologia e soluções, ou orquestrar o desenvolvimento interno, sempre visando a melhor abordagem para as necessidades da Supercomm.
  • Interface Estratégica: Atuar como um elo vital entre o C-level e as equipes técnicas, traduzindo a visão executiva em planos acionáveis e garantindo a comunicação fluida entre todas as partes interessadas.
  • Análise de Dados : Utilizar dados, incluindo informações do DataLake, para embasar decisões estratégicas, otimizar produtos e identificar novas oportunidades de inovação.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e Qualificações: Quem nós procuramos?

  • Graduação completa em áreas como Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de produtos, análise de negócios, gestão de projetos estratégicos ou consultoria em tecnologia.
  • Comprovada capacidade de interagir e influenciar stakeholders de alto nível, com excelente comunicação e habilidades de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Habilidade para transformar ideias de alto nível em requisitos detalhados e planos de ação concretos.
  • Familiaridade com o uso estratégico de dados e plataformas como Data Lakes para tomada de decisão.
  • Demonstra interesse e/ou experiência prévia em projetos de Inteligência Artificial e outras tecnologias emergentes.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) ou frameworks de inovação (Design Thinking).
  • Certificações em Gestão de Projetos (PMP, CSM) ou Gestão de Produtos (CSPO) são um diferencial.
  • Visão de negócio apurada e proatividade para identificar oportunidades e desafios.
  • Capacidade analítica apurada para identificar causas-raiz e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação para definição de requisitos e fluxos/processos.

Competências Supercomm:

  • Espírito Empreendedor: Visão de dono e proatividade para identificar oportunidades e desafios.
  • Atitude Digital: Adaptabilidade a novas tecnologias e processos, com mentalidade de inovação.
  • Velocidade: Habilidade para trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico, com foco em entregas rápidas e eficientes.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade analítica apurada para identificar causas-raiz e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Entendimento do Negócio: Visão estratégica para alinhar projetos de TI aos objetivos da empresa.
  • Colaboração: Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal para trabalhar em equipe.

Additional information

O Que Oferecemos: Seu crescimento conosco

Na Supercomm, investimos em nosso time porque sabemos que o seu sucesso é o nosso sucesso. Oferecemos um ambiente que estimula o Crescimento e a Valorização , com:

  • Pacote de benefícios abrangente: Salário competitivo, SulAmérica Saúde e Dental, Icatu Seguros, Swile (TotalPass) e PLR.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo: Oportunidades de crescimento e plano de desenvolvimento individual (PDI), com treinamentos e capacitações internas alinhados às suas metas.
  • Cultura de inovação: Atue em um ambiente que respira Atitude Digital e Velocidade , com desafios constantes que promovem o seu Espírito Empreendedor .
  • Ambiente colaborativo: Faça parte de um time que pratica o Respeito e a Colaboração , onde suas ideias são valorizadas.
  • Programas exclusivos: Participe dos nossos programas internos como #SuperInfluencers e #SuperIndicações , fortalecendo nossa cultura e o engajamento.
